Sei Shōnagon ( 清少納言 ; [sei ɕoː.naꜜ.ɡoɴ, seː-, -ŋoɴ] , [ 1 ] [ 2 ] c. 966–1017 or 1025) , or Seijo ( 清女 ; [seꜜi.(d)ʑo, seꜜː-] , [ 2 ] lit. ' Lady Sei ' ) , was a Japanese author, poet, and court lady who served the Empress Teishi (Sadako) around the year 1000, during the middle Heian period . She is the author of The Pillow Book ( 枕草子 , makura no sōshi ) .
